name: PdxIcon
description: An icon drawn as SVG from a registered set, inline markup or a URL, with accessibility built in.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name, submitted with the form.

members.name: set
members.description: Icon set to draw from (registered sets).

members.name: svg
members.description: Raw inline SVG markup to render.

members.name: src
members.description: URL of an external SVG to load.

members.name: size
members.description: Size of the control (e.g. sm, md, lg).

members.name: weight
members.description: Weight override: thin(1) light(1.5) regular(2) bold(2.5). Default: inherit from --pdx-icon-weight or 'regular'.

members.name: rtl
members.description: RTL behavior: 'mirror' flips in RTL context, 'none' keeps as-is. Default: 'none'.
